summary: BHP Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting an operational review for the nine months ended 31 March 2026. The report highlights strong performance in copper and iron ore, record production at Escondida and WAIO, and progress on copper growth projects including a permit application for a new concentrator and a milestone at Resolution Copper. It also notes completion of a silver streaming transaction with Wheaton Precious Metals for US$4.3 billion and finalization of divestments of Carajás, Blackwater, and Daunia. CEO succession is announced: Brandon Craig will become CEO on 1 July 2026, succeeding Mike Henry. This is a routine operational update with a CEO transition, but not a forced departure, so it does not fit special situations.
